name: Masturbating
overview: Scripture calls believers to exercise purity in thought and deed, as seen in Job's commitment to guard his eyes and avoid lustful thoughts (Job 31:1) and Jesus' teaching that lustful looking is equivalent to adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28). The struggle against sinful desires is acknowledged in Romans 7:15, where Paul describes the conflict between wanting to do right and the flesh's pull toward sin. Believers are urged to present their bodies as holy sacrifices to God (Romans 12:1) and to walk by the Spirit to overcome fleshly lusts (Galatians 5:16). Furthermore, Ephesians 5:3 exhorts the church to avoid all forms of sexual immorality and uncleanness, emphasizing the call to live in holiness as saints.
